name: mv
description:
Move or rename a file or directory. A directory moves with everything in it.

- `from` and `to` may be absolute or relative to the working directory; `to` must not exist yet.
- Inside one repository (a mount) the move is staged like any other change. Between a repository and the rest of the file system, or between two repositories, it is refused: read the file and write it where it should go instead.

to.description: The new path, including the name
